services.desc: The Manolin and Capt. Chris drfiting pogies on Joppa Flats during an awesome Merrimack River sunset Been a long while since I have posted a report up here. The fishing had remained solid since our last report at the end of July. We ran a lot of charters since then, but it was back to football and teaching with some fishing on the weekends. Now we are into the winter doldrums and I am already missing he boat as I look at it's looking lonely wrapped up in the yard. So many things to talk discuss about this past season. The general outlook was that it pretty slow all the way up and down the coast, with the exception of a few weeks of good fishing here and there. However, we made the best of it

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Happy Mother's Day to all the wonderful women who have loved and cared for us dudes since the beginning of time. We were fortunate up here to have a beautiful day to help show our appreciation for all the moms out there. Mother's Day is also special for another reason, it usually sets the stage for the beginning of our striped bass season up here on the Merrimac River. I took my Mom and Dad out today to scout around for the seasons first stripers! We went to all the usual jaunts from just out front of the beaches all the way up the river.
